scenes.text: Is this gold burger genius or a total scam?
Course four is a surprise. The chef takes that wagyu and builds a burger, a thick patty seared until the fat glistens, on a toasted brioche bun.
Next comes a spoonful of caviar, the salted eggs of the sturgeon fish. The rarest comes from an albino sturgeon, and can cost tens of thousands of dollars a kilo.
The finishing touch is real, edible, twenty four karat gold leaf. Did you already know? It is so thin, it is completely edible.
Team burger or team scam? Comment your pick below.
